visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a man in a car holding a small, black Insta360 GO Ultra camera. He is wearing a black tank top and looking directly at the lens. (2) He attaches the camera to a black 'LA' baseball cap and puts it on his head, demonstrating the POV setup. (3) He checks the camera's view on his smartphone while standing in a parking lot. (4) The scene shifts to a first-person perspective as he walks toward a beef noodle restaurant, following a woman and a young child holding hands. (5) Inside the restaurant, he is seen looking at a menu and then selecting various side dishes like beef tendons and tripe from a display. (6) He interacts playfully with the young boy at the table, using hand gestures that resemble a frame around the boy's face. (7) A montage follows showing him eating a large bowl of beef noodles and side dishes with high energy. (8) He finishes the entire meal, drinks the soup, and pats his stomach in satisfaction. (9) He stands up, collects his belongings, and leaves the restaurant. (10) The video concludes with a clean product shot of the Insta360 GO Ultra camera against a white background.
